name: fed_get_latest
description:
The newest observation that has a value for one FRED series (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis), by series id or shorthand.
Returns: series_id, title, units, frequency, date, value and last_updated; an error if none of the last 10 observations has a value.
Inputs: series_id (e.g. DGS10, UNRATE; wins over indicator) or indicator (gdp, unemployment, inflation (CPIAUCSL index), fed_rate, treasury_10y, treasury_2y, sp500, housing, retail, industrial, m2, pce); one is needed.
For history use fed_get_series; for several at once fed_get_common_indicators. Key: the api_key field of this tool's config (a FRED key); the shipped config sets none, so the tool runs in demo mode and returns synthetic values with a note. fred_custom_series reads FRED_API_KEY and returns live data.
Example: {"series_id": "DGS10"}

last_updated.description: When the series was last updated

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Quick access to the most recent value of any FRED series. Ideal for dashboards and real-time monitoring.
